observations: Photo 1 and 2 show stacks of wooden pallets, several stamped with an oval "EPAL" mark burned into the wood blocks, consistent with Euro-pallet style construction.
Pallets are stacked outdoors on bare earth strewn with litter, plastic bags and what looks like damp/muddy ground near a shipping container and parked vehicles.
Photo 3 shows a single pallet held up by a person; it is a simpler nailed slat pallet without visible block stamps, lighter in colour, looks different in build from the EPAL-stamped stack.
No scale, certificate, or weighing scene is shown in any photo.
No close-up of wood grain/moisture or insect damage is provided; general colour looks dry but cannot be confirmed from a photo alone.
Ground and surrounding debris suggest an informal scrapyard/recycling site, not a controlled dry storage area.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: No shot of wood grain/moisture meter; pallets sit on muddy, littered ground which does not support a 'clean, dry' claim visually.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, ticket, or weighing photo/video provided.
Oval EPAL stamp visible on blocks in photo 1 and photo 2.

risks.risk: Moisture content higher than claimed, affecting true weight and price-per-kg value
risks.proof: Video of a moisture meter reading on several pallets, or a timestamped weighing video
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/dry-unverified stock, not premium kiln-dried

risks.risk: Mixed lot quality: at least one pallet (photo 3) appears to be a non-EPAL, simpler build, lowering average lot value
risks.proof: Full-lot wide shot showing all pallets with stamps visible, or a count of EPAL vs non-EPAL units
risks.if_unproven: priced as mixed-grade lot, not pure EPAL lot

risks.risk: Hidden rot, nail damage, or missing boards on the underside of stacked pallets not visible in photos
risks.proof: Photos/video of undersides and any pallets from the middle of the stack
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming some units are damaged/unusable

risks.risk: Actual total weight/count may differ from the claimed 500 kg
risks.proof: Video of pallets being loaded onto a certified scale with reading visible
risks.if_unproven: priced on visual count/estimate only, not on the claimed weight

proof_requests: Video of the actual weighing on a certified scale with reading visible
Clear photo of every pallet in the lot (not just the top of the stack) showing stamps and condition
Close-up or moisture-meter reading on a few boards to support 'dry' claim
Shot of the underside of several pallets to check for rot or missing boards
response.reason: The item is a lot of wooden (partly EPAL-stamped) pallets, but all supplied comparables are for plastic pallets, which is a different material and market segment, so no valid cheapest/dearest match exists for pricing.
